notes.title: The Score Multiplier Bar Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone Color Chaos developer here with a quick update to tell you about the new bar that is now visible next to the score multiplier in Color Chaos.

This bar is a visual representation of you progress towards reaching the next score multiplier. It fills up when you chain enemy kills together,when full increases your score mutliplier up to a maximum of X5. Once you have started to chain enemy kills together if you fail to get an enemy kill within 3 seconds the bar will reset along with your score multiplier. 

I hope that this helps push you towards reaching the next score multiplier and improves your game experience. Furthermore I also hope it gives a clearer insight into how the multiplier system works and how far away you are from reaching the next multiplier.

As always patch notes can be found on the link below:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/ColorChaos/announcements/detail/876328108039319447

Stay tuned for more updates.

Thanks

notes.title: IMPORTANT GAMEPLAY CHANGES
notes.notes:
Hi everyone Color Chaos Developer here to tell you about some important changes to the game that have been rolled out in patch 1.1.1.

Firstly the game has been made more accessible and less punishing for new players in both Classic Mode and Turbo Classic Mode. In both of these game modes you will now start with an overshield that allows you to take an extra hit. 

I have been tweaking the dificulty of Classic Mode since launch as this is the mode that most players go to first to learn the mechanics of the game. The addition of an overshield Classic Mode and Turbo Classic Mode will make this a much gentler process for new players, and in general will make both gamemodes alot less punishing overall for eveyone else. Chaos Mode and Turbo Chaos Mode remain unchanged however.

Secondly there have been some tweaks to the score values that enemys give upon death. Score values have been doubled in some areas and slighly raised in others. This will allow all players to reach higher scores faster and speed up the rate at which you unlock achivements,creating a greater sense of progression in the game.

More details on the changes mentioned above can be found in the patch notes. http://steamcommunity.com/games/ColorChaos/announcements/detail/883082560910540674

Look out for future updates and feel free to post sugestions over at the discussions page.

Thanks

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 is now available
notes.notes:
Patch 1.1.1 is now available. Patch notes can be found below:

Gameplay Changes:
/In Classic mode and Turbo Classic mode players start the game with an overshield.

/Score values for enemys have been changed. Please note the changes below are using a 1x multiplier. Changes are as follows:
.Cube enemy now gives 500 points instead of 250.
.Shooter enemy now gives 1000 points instead of 500.
.Bouncer enemy now gives 5000 points instead of 4000.
.Spinner enemy value of 20000 points remins unchanged.

/Spinner enemy health has been boosted from 50 heath to 60 health.

Please report any more bugs in the bug thread on the discusions page.

notes.title: Turbo Modes Now Available
notes.notes:
Turbo Classic and Turbo Chaos modes are now available!

- Turbo Classic Mode puts your reactions to the test as you fight of waves of enemies in a ultra-fast variant of Classic Mode.
- Turbo Chaos Mode pushes your abilities to the limit as you power-up and attempt to fight off onslaughts of enemies at maximum velocity! 

The Turbo modes update also adds: 
- 10 new achivements to unlock.
- 2 new leaderboards to compete in.
- new music.

alongside a host of other gameplay tweaks and enhancements which are detailed in the patch notes below.

http://steamcommunity.com/games/ColorChaos/announcements/detail/883081920173992085

Thanks for your continued support.

notes.title: Whats next for Color Chaos?????
notes.notes:
Color Chaos has been out for a week now. Its been great seeing you all enjoy the game and rise the ranks in the leaderboards. 

However some of you have been asking for something a little bit faster. Well today I'm pleased to announce that turbo modes are coming to Color Chaos very soon. Turbo mode will allow you to play both Classic and Chaos mode with significantly faster speed, and will launch alongside a host of new achievements for you to earn as-well as new leaderboards for you to compete in for both Turbo Classic and Turbo Chaos.

You will need fast reactions and quick thinking to rise to the top in turbo mode however im sure it will provide a new challenge for everyone to enjoy.

Stay tuned for future updates.

ːCubeEnemyː
